item.title: Nyx by Velixir – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.25

Nyx by Velixir – 1ml Sample Decant

Overview

Mysterious, smooth, and elegantly modern, Nyx by Velixir is a musky floral-woody fragrance with a soft, polished character. It opens with an airy freshness and gentle spice before developing into a smooth floral heart with a lightly powdery feel.

The dry-down becomes warmer and more comforting, blending clean musk, amber, and soft woods to create a refined trail that feels sophisticated without becoming heavy or overpowering.

Nyx is elegant, versatile, and quietly seductive—perfect for anyone who enjoys clean florals, smooth musk, and modern woody fragrances.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Violet Leaf
Middle: Iris, Jasmine, Lavender
Base: Musk, Amberwood, Sandalwood

Best For

Nyx works well for everyday wear, the office, dinners, date nights, and special occasions. Its soft floral freshness makes it easy to wear during the daytime, while the warm musky woods give it enough depth for evenings.

This falls into the “clean elegant signature scent” category—fresh and airy at first, smooth and floral through the middle, then warm, musky, and softly woody in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

Experience Nyx with a Decantified 1ml sample before purchasing a full bottle. Discover how the fragrance develops on your skin and make sure it is the right scent for you.

item.title: Harmonia by Velixir – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Rain Tea by Louis Vuitton
Type:
Price: 2.25

Harmonia by Velixir – 1ml Sample Decant

Overview

Fresh, calming, and effortlessly refined, Harmonia by Velixir is a green citrus-floral fragrance that blends aromatic tea, vibrant lemongrass, delicate flowers, and smooth transparent woods. It opens with a crisp rush of lemongrass and tea, delivering a bright herbal freshness with a clean citrus edge that feels peaceful, uplifting, and refreshing.

As it develops, rose and magnolia soften the sharper green opening and create an airy floral heart with a gentle natural sweetness. The dry-down settles into smooth woody notes, leaving a clean, lightly warm trail that feels polished without becoming heavy or overly sweet. Velixir describes Harmonia as a delicate, airy composition built around tea, lemongrass, rose, magnolia, and woods.

Harmonia delivers a crisp lemongrass-and-tea opening with a soft floral heart and a clean woody base—refreshing, elegant, and beautifully calming.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lemongrass, Tea
Middle: Rose, Magnolia
Base: Woody Notes

Inspired & Occasion

Harmonia sits in the green tea / citrus floral-woody lane and is commonly presented as an interpretation of Rain Tea by Louis Vuitton. Both fragrances revolve around the same combination of lemongrass, tea, magnolia, rose, and light woods, creating the sensation of a peaceful garden refreshed by rainfall. The comparison comes from fragrance reviewers rather than an official collaboration between Velixir and Louis Vuitton.

It works especially well for the office, casual outings, brunch, vacations, outdoor activities, daytime dates, and moments when you want something clean and relaxing. Its citrus, tea, and green qualities make it ideal for spring and summer, while the soft florals and woods make it comfortable for year-round daytime wear.

This falls into the “calming clean signature scent” category—bright and herbal up top, airy and floral through the middle, then soft, smooth, and woody in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a fresh rush of lemongrass, creating a crisp green-citrus effect that feels bright without becoming sharply acidic. Tea quickly emerges underneath, adding a smooth, slightly grassy character that gives the fragrance its peaceful and relaxing personality.

Within 15–20 minutes, rose and magnolia begin to soften the brighter opening. The florals feel light and transparent rather than dense, creating a clean floral-tea profile with a subtle natural sweetness.

As it dries down, the lemongrass becomes quieter while soft woods create a smooth and lightly warm foundation. The result is an airy, elegant fragrance that smells clean, soothing, and naturally sophisticated without becoming heavily musky, sweet, or powdery. Rain Tea is similarly described around lemongrass, tea, magnolia, rose, and transparent woods.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Selene by Velixir – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Moon Tale by Louis Vuitton
Type:
Price: 2.25

Overview

Radiant, fruity, and elegantly floral, Selene by Velixir is a floral-fruity fragrance that blends juicy raspberry, delicate peony, luminous white florals, and clean musk. It opens with raspberry and peony, delivering a soft, slightly sweet fruitiness surrounded by a fresh floral brightness that feels graceful and inviting rather than sharp.

As it develops, magnolia, jasmine sambac, and rose geranium create a rich floral heart with creamy white-floral depth and a fresh rosy-green touch. The dry-down settles into a soft floral musk accord, leaving a clean, smooth, and lightly powdery trail that feels airy, polished, and feminine-leaning. Velixir officially classifies Selene around floral, fruity, and white-floral accords.

Selene delivers a soft raspberry-and-peony opening with a luminous floral heart and a clean musky base—fresh, elegant, and effortlessly radiant.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Raspberry, Peony
Middle: Magnolia, Jasmine Sambac, Rose Geranium
Base: Soft Floral Musk Accord

Inspired & Occasion

Selene sits in the fruity floral / clean white-musk lane and is widely presented as an interpretation of Moon Tale by Louis Vuitton. Both fragrances revolve around the same combination of raspberry, peony, magnolia, jasmine sambac, and rose geranium, creating a bright, soft, and luxurious floral profile. The comparison is reported by fragrance reviewers and sellers rather than stated as an official collaboration by Velixir.

It works especially well for the office, brunch, daytime dates, casual outings, vacations, weddings, and special occasions. Its airy fruit and florals make it especially suitable for spring and summer, although the clean musk base makes it easy to wear throughout the year.

This falls into the “radiant clean floral scent” category—soft and fruity up top, elegant and floral through the middle, then clean, musky, and lightly powdery in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a soft rush of raspberry and peony, creating a juicy floral sweetness without becoming overly syrupy. The raspberry provides a bright fruity accent while peony gives the opening a fresh, delicate, almost petal-like quality.

Within 15–20 minutes, magnolia, jasmine sambac, and rose geranium become more noticeable. The fragrance grows fuller and more floral, combining creamy white flowers with a fresh rosy-green edge while maintaining its smooth, polished character.

As it dries down, the brighter fruit gradually fades into a soft floral musk accord. The result is a clean, radiant finish that feels lightly powdery and skin-like rather than heavy, woody, or overly sweet.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Hawas Venom by Rasasi – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.25

Overview

Dark, smoky, and powerfully masculine, Hawas Venom by Rasasi is an amber-woody fragrance that blends resinous incense, warm labdanum, rugged leather, earthy patchouli, and smooth vanilla. It opens with incense and labdanum, delivering a dense, smoky introduction with warm amber sweetness and a dark balsamic character.

As it develops, leather moves to the center of the fragrance, creating a bold, slightly animalic heart that feels mature, commanding, and mysterious. The dry-down combines vanilla, patchouli, and returning incense, leaving a warm smoky trail with earthy woods and a smooth sweetness that softens the darker elements.

Hawas Venom delivers a smoky incense-and-labdanum opening with a powerful leather heart and a dark vanilla-patchouli base—rich, intense, and made to leave an impression.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Incense, Labdanum
Middle: Leather
Base: Vanilla, Patchouli, Incense

Inspired & Occasion

Hawas Venom sits in the smoky amber / leather vanilla lane. Unlike the fresh and aquatic fragrances normally associated with the Hawas collection, Venom moves in a darker direction built around incense, resinous amber, leather, earthy patchouli, and masculine vanilla. Rasasi has not confirmed it as an interpretation of one specific fragrance, so it is best presented as an original composition rather than a direct clone.

It shines best during fall and winter, especially for evenings, date nights, upscale dinners, formal occasions, parties, and nights out. Its dense incense, leather, labdanum, and patchouli profile may feel heavy during extreme heat, but it should develop beautifully in cooler temperatures.

This falls into the “dark seductive statement scent” category—smoky and resinous up top, bold and leathery through the middle, then warm, earthy, and smoothly sweet in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a powerful rush of incense and labdanum, creating a smoky amber effect with a warm, slightly sticky resinous sweetness. It immediately feels darker and heavier than the traditional fruity-aquatic Hawas style.

Within 15–20 minutes, leather begins to take over, adding a rugged and commanding character. The incense remains present in the background, surrounding the leather with smoke and warm balsamic depth.

As it dries down, vanilla begins smoothing the composition while patchouli introduces an earthy, woody quality. The returning incense keeps the sweetness dark and mysterious, resulting in a rich masculine fragrance with a smoky vanilla-leather trail.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Shiyaaka Sky by Khadlaj – 1ml Sample Decant

Overview

Bright, green, and effortlessly clean, Shiyaaka Sky by Khadlaj is a citrus-aromatic fragrance that blends sparkling citrus, fresh herbs, delicate white florals, and smooth musky woods. It opens with verbena, bergamot, and mandarin, delivering a vibrant citrus burst with a crisp green edge that feels refreshing, uplifting, and polished.

As it develops, orange blossom, neroli, geranium, and green accords create a clean aromatic heart with a soft floral character. The dry-down settles into musk, ambroxan, sandalwood, and vetiver, leaving a smooth, lightly powdery trail with creamy woods and subtle earthy depth.

Shiyaaka Sky delivers a sparkling citrus-and-verbena opening with an airy floral heart and a smooth musky-wood base—fresh, refined, and made for effortless everyday wear.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Verbena, Bergamot, Mandarin
Middle: Orange Blossom, Neroli, Green Accord, Geranium
Base: Musk, Ambroxan, Sandalwood, Vetiver

Inspired & Occasion

Shiyaaka Sky sits in the green citrus / aromatic floral-musk lane and is being compared by early reviewers to Herbes Troublantes by Guerlain. Both fragrances combine sparkling citrus, aromatic greenery, orange blossom, soft florals, musk, and woods. Shiyaaka Sky appears to offer a smoother, slightly creamier interpretation through sandalwood, ambroxan, and vetiver. Khadlaj has not officially identified the inspiration, so the comparison should be treated as an early fragrance-community assessment.

It works especially well for the office, business meetings, casual outings, vacations, outdoor activities, daytime dates, and warm-weather gatherings. Its citrus and green notes make it ideal for spring and summer, while the smooth musk and woods give it enough structure for year-round daytime wear.

This falls into the “clean sophisticated signature scent” category—sparkling and green up top, floral and aromatic through the middle, then smooth, musky, and softly woody in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a lively rush of verbena, bergamot, and mandarin, creating a crisp citrus effect with a fresh herbal edge. The verbena keeps the opening green and energizing, while mandarin adds a smoother touch of juicy sweetness.

Within 15–20 minutes, orange blossom, neroli, geranium, and green accords begin to soften the brighter citrus. The fragrance develops a clean, naturally elegant character that feels floral and lightly powdery without becoming overly sweet. Early impressions describe it as fresh, green, slightly herbal, and exceptionally clean.

As it dries down, sandalwood introduces a creamy woody texture while vetiver adds a dry, earthy freshness. Musk and ambroxan create a clean, softly warm foundation that keeps the fragrance polished and comfortable on the skin.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Game of Spades Trick by Jo Milano Paris – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Louis Vuitton Cactus Garden
Type:
Price: 2.75

Overview

Bright, green, and effortlessly refreshing, Game of Spades Trick by Jo Milano Paris is a citrus-aromatic fragrance that blends sparkling bergamot, crisp cucumber, juicy watermelon, herbal lemongrass, and smooth mate tea. It opens with a lively green-citrus burst, delivering a clean and slightly sweet freshness that feels cool, uplifting, and perfect for warm weather.

As it develops, cucumber and watermelon create a watery, refreshing character while mate tea and lemongrass add a dry herbal edge. A soft coconut accord brings a smooth tropical touch without making the fragrance smell creamy or sunscreen-like. The dry-down settles into amber, vanilla, incense, and clean musk, leaving a softly sweet, woody-musky trail with some of the green freshness remaining in the background. Reported note listings vary slightly because this is a brand-new release, but the consistent profile centers on cucumber, watermelon, lemongrass, mate tea, citrus, and a smooth musky base.

Game of Spades Trick delivers a bright green-citrus opening with a refreshing cucumber-and-mate heart and a clean, softly sweet musky base—fresh, modern, and easy to enjoy.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Lemongrass, Cucumber, Watermelon
Middle: Mate Tea, Green Notes, Watery Coconut
Base: Amber, Vanilla, Incense, Soft Musk

Inspired & Occasion

Game of Spades Trick sits in the green citrus / aromatic fresh lane and is widely presented as an interpretation of Louis Vuitton Cactus Garden. Cactus Garden is known for its combination of sparkling bergamot, herbal lemongrass, and earthy green mate tea. Trick follows that refreshing foundation while introducing cucumber, watermelon, watery coconut, amber, and vanilla for a slightly sweeter and more playful interpretation.

It shines best during spring and summer, especially on hot days when its watery fruits, green herbs, and bright citrus can feel especially refreshing. It’s an excellent choice for vacations, pool days, outdoor activities, casual outings, the office, daytime dates, and anytime you want to smell freshly showered and clean.

This falls into the “luxurious green summer scent” category—bright and juicy up top, herbal and refreshing through the middle, then clean, softly sweet, and musky in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a vibrant rush of bergamot and lemongrass, creating a bright green-citrus effect with a slightly sweet edge. Cucumber and watermelon quickly add a cool, watery freshness that prevents the herbal notes from becoming too sharp or bitter.

Within 15–20 minutes, mate tea becomes more noticeable, giving the fragrance a smooth, leafy character. The green opening gradually softens into a clean, luxurious soap-like freshness, while watery coconut adds a subtle tropical smoothness. Early wearers describe this stage as fresh green citrus transitioning into an upscale, clean-soap effect.

As it dries down, amber and vanilla introduce gentle warmth and sweetness while incense and soft musk create a clean, lightly woody foundation. The result is a refreshing green fragrance that remains smooth, approachable, and easy to wear without becoming overly aquatic or heavily sweet.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Hawas Rouge by Rasasi – 1ml Sample Decant

Overview

Juicy, floral, and confidently feminine, Hawas Rouge by Rasasi is a fruity amber-floral fragrance that blends sparkling citrus, ripe pear, romantic white florals, creamy vanilla, and warm patchouli. It opens with bergamot, pear, and pink pepper, delivering a bright fruity introduction with juicy sweetness and a lightly spicy edge.

As it develops, rose, jasmine, and orange blossom create a smooth floral heart that feels radiant, elegant, and slightly creamy. The dry-down settles into vanilla, patchouli, amber, and musk, leaving a warm, sweet, and softly powdery trail with enough earthy depth to keep the fragrance balanced.

Hawas Rouge delivers a sparkling pear-and-bergamot opening with a rich floral heart and a warm vanilla-amber base—sweet, elegant, and attention-grabbing.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Pear, Pink Pepper
Middle: Rose, Jasmine, Orange Blossom
Base: Vanilla, Patchouli, Amber, Musk

Inspired & Occasion

Hawas Rouge sits in the fruity floral / warm vanilla-amber lane and is commonly compared to Sì Passione by Giorgio Armani. Both fragrances feature a bright pear opening, a romantic rose-centered floral heart, and a warm woody-vanilla base. Hawas Rouge expands the profile with bergamot, pink pepper, jasmine, orange blossom, patchouli, amber, and musk, creating a fuller and slightly warmer interpretation. Rasasi has not officially confirmed the inspiration, so the comparison should be treated as an early fragrance-community assessment.

It works especially well for dates, dinners, parties, celebrations, casual outings, and nights out. Its juicy fruits and bright florals make it wearable during spring and summer, while the vanilla, amber, musk, and patchouli provide enough warmth for fall and cooler evenings.

This falls into the “bold feminine compliment scent” category—bright and juicy up top, romantic and floral through the middle, then warm, sweet, and sensual in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a juicy rush of pear and bergamot, creating a bright fruity effect with a slightly tart citrus edge. Pink pepper introduces a gentle spicy sparkle that makes the opening feel energetic without becoming sharp.

Within 15–20 minutes, rose, jasmine, and orange blossom begin to take over, smoothing the fruitiness and creating a richer floral character. The heart feels feminine and elegant, with enough sweetness to remain modern and approachable.

As it dries down, vanilla adds creamy sweetness while amber and musk create warmth and softness. Patchouli introduces an earthy woody depth that balances the sweeter notes and gives the fragrance a more mature finish.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Hawas Nautilus by Rasasi – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Xerjoff 40 Knots
Type:
Price: 2.25

Overview

Fresh, mineral, and smoothly woody, Hawas Nautilus by Rasasi is an aromatic aquatic fragrance that captures the feeling of cool sea air, salty water, coastal woods, and sun-warmed sand. It opens with a clean combination of sea water and ambergris, delivering a crisp marine introduction with a salty, slightly mineral character that feels airy, refreshing, and refined.

As it develops, cedar and cypress introduce a dry aromatic woodiness that gives the fragrance more structure and masculine depth. The dry-down settles into driftwood and sand, leaving a smooth, earthy coastal trail with subtle warmth beneath the fresher aquatic opening.

Hawas Nautilus delivers a salty marine opening with a rugged cedar-and-cypress heart and a warm driftwood base—clean, sophisticated, and inspired by life along the open sea.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Ambergris, Sea Water
Middle: Cedar, Cypress
Base: Driftwood, Sand

Inspired & Occasion

Hawas Nautilus sits in the marine aquatic / aromatic woody lane and is being widely compared by early fragrance reviewers to Xerjoff 40 Knots. Both fragrances focus on the feeling of open water, salty sea air, polished woods, and the luxurious atmosphere of sailing along the coast. Xerjoff officially presents 40 Knots around a Mediterranean yacht-club theme, while Nautilus uses clearly listed marine, cedar, cypress, driftwood, and sandy notes to create its interpretation. Rasasi has not publicly confirmed the comparison, so it is best treated as an early reviewer consensus rather than an official inspiration statement.

It works especially well for vacations, boating, beach days, resort wear, casual outings, daytime events, and warm-weather evenings. Its cool marine opening suits spring and summer, while the cedar, cypress, and driftwood give it enough depth for breezy nights and year-round daytime use.

This falls into the “luxurious coastal signature scent” category—salty and refreshing up top, aromatic and woody through the middle, then dry, earthy, and sun-warmed in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a rush of sea water and ambergris, creating the impression of a cool ocean breeze with a clean, salty, and slightly mineral edge. It feels aquatic without relying on a heavily fruity or overly sweet opening.

As it begins to settle, cedar and cypress emerge, adding an aromatic coastal-forest quality and a drier woody structure. The fragrance gradually becomes warmer and smoother as the marine freshness moves into the background.

In the dry-down, driftwood and sand create an earthy, sun-warmed foundation that balances the cooler opening. The result is a refined aquatic fragrance that feels clean and refreshing while maintaining a distinctive woody, coastal personality.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Marasi For Him by Arabiyat Prestige – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Loewe Solo Elixir
Type:
Price: 2.25

Overview

Warm, aromatic, and elegantly masculine, Marasi For Him by Arabiyat Prestige is an amber-spicy fragrance that blends bright mandarin, calming lavender, powdery iris, warm spices, and deep balsamic resins. It opens with lavender, mandarin, and jasmine sambac, delivering a fresh aromatic introduction with smooth citrus brightness and a soft floral touch.

As it develops, orris, cinnamon, nutmeg, and olibanum create a warm, powdery heart with creamy iris, comforting spice, and a smoky incense-like depth. The dry-down settles into tarragon, benzoin, labdanum, and patchouli, leaving a rich amber trail that feels herbal, earthy, resinous, and slightly sweet.

Marasi For Him delivers a fresh lavender-and-mandarin opening with a powdery, spicy iris heart and a warm balsamic-amber base—classy, distinctive, and confidently refined.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lavender, Mandarin, Jasmine Sambac
Middle: Orris, Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Olibanum
Base: Tarragon, Benzoin, Labdanum, Patchouli

Inspired & Occasion

Marasi For Him sits in the powdery amber / aromatic spicy lane and is closely inspired by Loewe Solo Elixir. Both fragrances feature a nearly identical combination of lavender, mandarin, jasmine sambac, orris, cinnamon, nutmeg, olibanum, patchouli, and warm rockrose-style resins. Marasi adds tarragon and benzoin to give the dry-down a sweeter, more herbal and balsamic character.

It shines best during fall, winter, and cooler evenings, when its cinnamon, incense, iris, benzoin, and labdanum can fully develop. It’s an excellent choice for the office, elegant dinners, date nights, formal occasions, special events, or anytime you want a mature scent that feels polished and expensive.

This falls into the “classy amber signature scent” category—fresh and aromatic up top, powdery and warmly spiced through the middle, then rich, resinous, and earthy in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a smooth combination of lavender and mandarin, creating a fresh aromatic effect with a gentle citrus sweetness. Jasmine sambac introduces a soft floral quality that keeps the opening refined rather than sharp or overly fresh.

Within 15–20 minutes, orris becomes more noticeable, giving the fragrance a creamy, powdery texture. Cinnamon and nutmeg add warmth while olibanum introduces a smoky resinous character, making the heart feel richer and more sophisticated.

As it dries down, benzoin and labdanum create a warm amber sweetness while patchouli adds earthy woody depth. Tarragon brings a subtle herbal edge that prevents the base from feeling too heavy or syrupy. The result is a smooth, elegant fragrance with a powdery iris-and-amber trail.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Signature Brown by Fragrance World – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Bois Impérial by Essential Parfums
Type:
Price: 2.99

Overview

Green, spicy, and smoothly woody, Signature Brown by Fragrance World is a woody-aromatic fragrance that blends fresh basil, cracked pepper, smoky vetiver, and earthy modern woods. It opens with an energizing combination of basil and pepper, delivering a sharp herbal introduction with a fresh spicy bite and a slightly green, cooling character.

As it develops, vetiver and woody notes create a dry, smoky heart that feels clean, sophisticated, and grounded. The dry-down settles into patchouli and Akigalawood, leaving an earthy, peppery wood trail with subtle resinous warmth and a polished modern finish. Fragrance World’s catalogue lists pepper and basil over vetiver, woody notes, patchouli, and Akigalawood.

Signature Brown delivers a fresh basil-and-pepper opening with a smoky vetiver heart and a deep patchouli-wood base—green, refined, and confidently distinctive.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pepper, Basil
Middle: Vetiver, Woody Notes
Base: Patchouli, Akigalawood

Inspired & Occasion

Signature Brown sits in the green aromatic / spicy woody lane and is commonly compared to Bois Impérial by Essential Parfums. It carries a similar combination of peppery freshness, aromatic greenery, vetiver, patchouli, and modern textured woods. Signature Brown is generally described as softer, greener, and more approachable, with greater emphasis on basil and less of the sharp metallic woodiness associated with Bois Impérial. The comparison is made by fragrance reviewers rather than officially stated by Fragrance World.

It’s highly versatile and works especially well for the office, business meetings, dinners, casual outings, daytime events, and warm-weather evenings. The green herbs and pepper keep it fresh enough for spring and summer, while the smoky vetiver, patchouli, and Akigalawood provide enough depth for cooler days.

This falls into the “refined woody signature scent” category—green and peppery up top, dry and smoky through the middle, then earthy, warm, and smoothly woody in the dry-down.

Try Before You Commit

The fragrance opens with a noticeable rush of fresh basil and pepper, creating a sharp herbal effect with a lively spicy edge. The basil gives it a green, almost leafy freshness, while the pepper makes the opening feel crisp and energetic.

Within 15–20 minutes, vetiver and dry woods begin to take over, calming the herbal opening and introducing a smoother, smokier character. The fragrance becomes more grounded and sophisticated without turning overly dark or heavy.

As it dries down, patchouli adds earthy warmth while Akigalawood creates a textured combination of peppery spice, resinous woods, and subtle smoky depth. The result is a modern, versatile fragrance that smells clean and natural while still having a distinctive woody presence.

Try it first with a Decantified sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Glitch by Mykonos – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Creed Aventus × Roja Elysium
Type:
Price: 2.49

Overview

Fresh, fruity, and confidently modern, Glitch by Mykonos is a citrus-aromatic fragrance that blends sparkling grapefruit, crisp apple, smoky pineapple, clean florals, and smooth amber woods. It opens with an energetic combination of Sicilian bergamot, apple, grapefruit, and charred pineapple, delivering a bright citrus-fruity introduction with a smoky tropical edge.

As it develops, lavender, artemisia, lily of the valley, pink pepper, dried jasmine, and vanilla create a clean aromatic heart with a balance of fresh spice, soft florals, and subtle sweetness. The dry-down settles into white musk, cedarwood, moss, amber, patchouli, and smoky woods, leaving a polished woody trail with earthy depth and a smooth masculine finish.
